S.FORM: Halus kwara bnkisan na Tayal ga, maki utux cyoli' hiya ga wa pcyan lalu, Halus lalu nya, ungat ima yani hi nya tyaba, trhaw babow urow hiya ga, innbyan nya hiya ga mnanak ro glahang ci, urow wayal nya snyahow ga wayan tkiyu ro nya tbutul tegan uy, mnanak ci utas nya, ungat utas ima thuyey cpung utas nya, kruyux ci utas nya knkuxun mita cyoli, iwan bni'an hwey na lutux, krryax kryax utas nya ga ble'un nya sbhul syow olu nya ro hwinuk nya kya, ana mosuw utas nya ga kba' mkukuw llyuw utas nya uy. kyaku 'lyan skura mnayang mayah kwara mlikuy utux alang hiya ga, Halus kwe ga s'agan nya kwara knba'an nya musa mgnow nya bley ci mlahang sali kwara ana ima na knerin, kyaku maki knerin knapal nya ga musa sgali' kwara pipi naha, yihul ci ga kruma knerin knahul yow kwe ro musa mhoyil uy, gbyan ana wayal ble'un ci pkat 'lu sali uy ga, Halus ga musa pwah suruw Sali naha ro kyupan nya tubung kya tyaba utas nya, musa nya ci ba'un tmring knerin nya maki iyik Sali kya, trang tyaba mwalah, s'unu ro hmor 'sya ga, plwanun nya gluw Tayal hiya musa ciyak na bcilung, skahul nya tyaba utas nya skbaley nya utux hongu, sa'ing 'ba nya ga galan sc'ruw, musa myasa wahan naha hongu. siga mlikuy pwah hongu ga musa miyiy ci wahan hongu, kyaku knerin ro krakis musa pwah hongu ga, yani ci khoni lbing khetuy ci utas nya, kryax ga musa ungat ya'eh yow mhtuw. cinkhulan sa knita' sa brbiru 江明清 Yawi‧Nomin,
S.PHON: ħalu[s|ɕ] kwara βnki[s|ɕ]an na tajal ɣa maki utux [ʦ|ʨ]joliʔ ħija ɣa wa p[ʦ|ʨ]jan lalu ħalu[s|ɕ] lalu nja uŋat ima jani ħi nja tjaβa trħaw βaβow urow ħija ɣa innβjan nja ħija ɣa mnanak ro ɣlaħaŋ [ʦ|ʨ]i urow wajal nja [s|ɕ]njaħow ɣa wajan tkiju ro nja tβutul teɣan uj mnanak [ʦ|ʨ]i uta[s|ɕ] nja uŋat uta[s|ɕ] ima tħujej [ʦ|ʨ]puŋ uta[s|ɕ] nja krujux [ʦ|ʨ]i uta[s|ɕ] nja knkuxun mita [ʦ|ʨ]joli iwan βniʔan ħwej na lutux krrjax krjax uta[s|ɕ] nja ɣa βleʔun nja [s|ɕ]βħul [s|ɕ]jow olu nja ro ħwinuk nja kja ana mo[s|ɕ]uw uta[s|ɕ] nja ɣa kβaʔ mkukuw lljuw uta[s|ɕ] nja uj kjaku ʔljan [s|ɕ]kura mnajaŋ majaħ kwara mlikuj utux alaŋ ħija ɣa ħalu[s|ɕ] kwe ɣa [s|ɕ]ʔaɣan nja kwara knβaʔan nja mu[s|ɕ]a mɣnow nja βlej [ʦ|ʨ]i mlaħaŋ [s|ɕ]ali kwara ana ima na knerin kjaku maki knerin knapal nja ɣa mu[s|ɕ]a [s|ɕ]ɣaliʔ kwara pipi naħa jiħul [ʦ|ʨ]i ɣa kruma knerin knaħul jow kwe ro mu[s|ɕ]a mħojil uj ɣβjan ana wajal βleʔun [ʦ|ʨ]i pkat ʔlu [s|ɕ]ali uj ɣa ħalu[s|ɕ] ɣa mu[s|ɕ]a pwaħ [s|ɕ]uruw [s|ɕ]ali naħa ro kjupan nja tuβuŋ kja tjaβa uta[s|ɕ] nja mu[s|ɕ]a nja [ʦ|ʨ]i βaʔun tmriŋ knerin nja maki ijik [s|ɕ]ali kja traŋ tjaβa mwalaħ [s|ɕ]ʔunu ro ħmor ʔ[s|ɕ]ja ɣa plwanun nja ɣluw tajal ħija mu[s|ɕ]a [ʦ|ʨ]ijak na β[ʦ|ʨ]iluŋ [s|ɕ]kaħul nja tjaβa uta[s|ɕ] nja [s|ɕ]kβalej nja utux ħoŋu [s|ɕ]aʔiŋ ʔβa nja ɣa ɣalan [s|ɕ][ʦ|ʨ]ʔruw mu[s|ɕ]a mja[s|ɕ]a waħan naħa ħoŋu [s|ɕ]iɣa mlikuj pwaħ ħoŋu ɣa mu[s|ɕ]a mijij [ʦ|ʨ]i waħan ħoŋu kjaku knerin ro kraki[s|ɕ] mu[s|ɕ]a pwaħ ħoŋu ɣa jani [ʦ|ʨ]i kħoni lβiŋ kħetuj [ʦ|ʨ]i uta[s|ɕ] nja krjax ɣa mu[s|ɕ]a uŋat jaʔeħ jow mħtuw [ʦ|ʨ]inkħulan [s|ɕ]a knitaʔ [s|ɕ]a βrβiru *** jawinomin
